author: "Alfie Swinton"

library(tidyverse)
library(gt)

make a table for covid 19 cases
```{r}
cvdcases <- read_csv("ukhsa-chart-download.csv")
gt(cvdcases)
```

make a plot of the data 
```{r}
ggplot(cvdcases, aes(
  x = date,
  y = metric_value
)) + 
  geom_line(colour = "green") +
  xlab("Date") + 
  ylab("Cases per 100000")+
  ggtitle("Cases of Covid-19 per 100000 over time")

```
